hypothesis: Order of first distinct hex digits in blue cell indices supplies a substitution alphabet for DBBI prefix tokens.
status: Hypothesis; neither the b/g parse nor this alphabet operation is creator-confirmed.

variants.alphabet_construction: First distinct hex digits of blue indices; three traversals (row/column/known URL spiral), forward/backward, row-major numbering 0/1-based; append/prepend missing digits in 0..f order.
variants.aes: All three original blobs, AES-256-CBC, EVP_BytesToKey SHA256 and MD5. No invented IV or derived ciphertext.

acceptance: Exact prize public key (or its negation, invertible), or independently verifiable complete plaintext. Padding/printable ratio are triage only.
